summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by Herse — by lot the bride of Daiphron son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Adiante second among the daughters of Danaus borne on Herse. When the youngest sons of Egyptus by Hephaestine cast lots, Daiphron drew Adiante. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom — Hyginus counts her among the brides who obeyed Danaus.
